findings.title: Measured JSON gateway encoding constrains high-body stream
findings.mechanism: Equivalent frozen poses on the same scheduler take longer to encode as JSON; fewer useful frames reach receivers
findings.impact: At 10k ? 8 final runs: JSON 61.226 ms encode p95 / 50 frames per receiver; binary 2.423 ms / 91 frames, about three seconds
findings.proposal: Retain JSON default and make binary explicit; do not generalize to physics or rendering

findings.title: Relative sleeps accumulate Windows wakeup quantization
findings.mechanism: Requested 33.333 ms relative sleeps woke near 46.60 ms; fixed deadlines and faster monitor polling remove measured tiny-scene cadence loss
findings.proposal: Retain local deadlines and latest-frame semantics; avoid changing global timer settings

findings.title: Default environment cannot collect one optional simulation module
findings.mechanism: test_mesh_export imports warp before optional Newton skip; isolated P2-A environment has no simulation extras
findings.proposal: Run unchanged simulation consumers in the PM integration environment; no simulation pass claimed here
